description: This Java class represents a selection criteria for MongoDB operations, encapsulating a collection name and a BSON filter, and providing methods for creation, comparison, and description of the selection.

classes.name: MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection
classes.description: An immutable class representing a MongoDB collection selection with filter criteria, providing methods for creating instances, accessing properties, and representing the selection as a string.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new selection instance with specified collection name and filter.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the MongoDB collection.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns a copy of the filter Document used in the selection.

methods.name: isEntireCollection
methods.description: Checks whether the filter is empty, indicating the selection applies to the entire collection.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this object and another, based on collectionName and filter.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on collectionName and filter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the selection, indicating whether it targets the entire collection or a filtered subset.
